objective: Implement parameter-free completed-4H close breakout memory predicate with immutable post-entry structure, default-disabled shadow integration and synthetic native parity; no trigger or exit action
summary: Pure immutable structural state evaluates each new eligible completed 4H close strictly above the prior post-entry structural high, initially entry price, before incorporating the current high. Pre-entry and entry-spanning bars are excluded. Exact duplicates emit no repeated event; conflicts and backward chronology fail closed. An explicitly enabled run-local policy returns memory booleans through the existing adapter and async-memory API, never triggers or exits. All 267 synthetic cases and Ruff pass, with full native parity against disabled mode and the task-start implementation.
north_star_effect: Advances reproducible causal exit-brain memory logic without changing trading behavior or claiming economic performance. The new observable predicate replaces no historical formula and has no authority to trigger exits.

files.change: Created pure immutable structural fold and isolated lifecycle policy registry with non-economic diagnostics
Optional predicate registration using actual entry price and exact lifecycle ID; predicate cleanup on existing native close hook
Explicit disabled predicate switch, policy wiring, entry-price handoff and separate diagnostics sink; native decisions unchanged
Created 51 synthetic pure-state, causality, isolation, cleanup and native-parity cases

implementation.formula: memory_observed = current.close > max(entry_price, highs of all previously processed eligible completed 4H snapshots with prior.bar_close_time < current.bar_close_time)
implementation.entry_boundary: Conservative full-post-entry contract: bar_open_time >= actual native entry_time. Pre-entry completions, bars closing exactly at entry, and bars spanning entry are excluded from both predicate observations and structural high. A bar opening exactly at entry becomes eligible at its close. No pre-entry high is used to make breakout harder.
implementation.causal_boundary: bar_close_time <= decision_time; no unfinished or future snapshot may enter the predicate. UTC normalized by existing adapter context. Strictly ordered non-overlapping new snapshot identities; conflicting frontier duplicates and backwards decisions fail closed.
update_order: validate exact position/symbol/entry binding and causal availability
reject out-of-order/conflicting snapshots or return no-op for identical frontier duplicate
exclude bars not fully post-entry without changing structure/count
only then set structural_high=max(prior structural_high,current.high) and increment eligible count
return typed memory boolean to existing adapter/async-memory machinery
implementation.duplicate_contract: Batch duplicates normalize under the unchanged adapter. Repeated selection of the last snapshot yields no policy observation, unchanged structural state and no repeated memory/episode update. An old snapshot behind the current frontier fails closed rather than rewinding. Full snapshot content participates in conflict detection.
implementation.default_configuration: observable_memory_predicate_enabled=False. The existing adapter NO_OBSERVATION default is unchanged. Enabling the predicate requires adapter and async-memory shadow explicitly enabled; combining it with a custom adapter policy fails closed rather than silently overriding it.
implementation.integration: Replay sends actual native admission price/time to the optional predicate registry through the existing shadow admission hook. Full lifecycle IDs own immutable structural states. The unchanged adapter invokes this policy with minimal context and latest completed snapshot. Existing AsyncMemoryReplayShadow._apply_observation calls observe_async_memory for returned memory booleans. No policy value enters trading decisions.
implementation.stream_completeness: Native RD27 visits hourly boundaries; normalized bars are exact 4H and non-overlapping per symbol. Therefore every available post-entry 4H completion is selected before any later completion supersedes it. Off-grid closes are observed at the first subsequent hourly boundary, explicitly tested. The pure fold expects its caller to supply each eligible snapshot in chronological order.
implementation.observation_time: Existing adapter contract is preserved: event timestamp is the actual causal decision boundary, not backdated to a source close. Source snapshot identity/close are retained in true-event diagnostics. Aligned closes observe exactly at close; a 5.5-hour close first observes at hour 6.
implementation.continuation_after_true: Structural calculation continues after memory establishment, including false booleans. Generic AsyncMemoryState alone owns memory latching, first/latest times, previous flag and episodes. A false predicate does not erase latched memory.
implementation.cleanup: On every existing native close, V1 memory resets as before and the optional structural registry removes active state. Diagnostics retain the terminal structural summary. Later same-pair positions have new exact IDs and start again from their own entry prices; previously used IDs cannot be reused.
implementation.diagnostic_count_semantics: Predicate evaluations count eligible unique snapshots only; true+false equals eligible count. Excluded entry bars and repeated selected snapshots are counted separately. Per-position first-true time and event history are diagnostics only, not runtime memory authority.
implementation.runtime_limits_preserved: Native replay still permits only one active position per pair; isolated same-symbol/different-ID policy states are additionally tested directly. Existing rejection of enabled shadow for delegated RD26 control remains unchanged.
